title: Shopping on Monday and Saturday
text:
Anna goes to the shop on Monday. She has a shopping list. The list has milk, bread, eggs and apples. She buys everything in twenty minutes.

On Saturday, Tom goes shopping with his mother. They need rice and tomatoes for dinner. Tom wants chocolate, but his mother says no. They buy the food and go home.

questions.text: What is on Anna's shopping list?
What do Tom and his mother need for dinner?
Why does Anna finish her shopping so quickly?
options: She knew exactly what she needed
She did not like the shop
She was buying food for a party

questions.text: What can we guess about Tom?

vocabulary.definition: a paper with the things you want to buy
a sweet brown food made from cocoa
the main meal of the day, often eaten in the evening

paragraph_translations: Anna idzie w poniedziałek do sklepu. Ma listę zakupów. Na liście są mleko, chleb, jajka i jabłka. Wszystko kupuje w dwadzieścia minut.
W sobotę Tom idzie na zakupy z mamą. Potrzebują ryżu i pomidorów na obiad. Tom chce czekoladę, ale mama mówi nie. Kupują jedzenie i wracają do domu.
